content:
# New Client Onboarding Process
#
# Human-readable process specification (not an executable pipeline).
# Defaults for trigger, owners, and SLAs are assumptions chosen without
# client input — adjust them to match your actual onboarding practice.

workflow:
  name: new-client-onboarding
  version: 1.0.0
  description: >
    Sequential onboarding process for new clients, from signed contract
    to delivery-team handoff.

# Assumption: the process starts when the contract is signed.
trigger:
  event: contract_signed
  initiated_by: account_manager

# Assumption: standard client-provided data at onboarding start.
inputs:
  - client_name
  - primary_contact
  - signed_contract
  - initial_requirements

steps:
  - id: intake
    name: Client Intake
    owner: account_manager
    sla: 2 business days
    description: Collect and verify client details, contracts, and initial requirements.
    outputs:
      - validated client profile
      - requirements summary

  - id: account-setup
    name: Account Setup
    owner: it_operations
    sla: 3 business days
    description: Create accounts, credentials, and access permissions.
    depends_on: intake
    outputs:
      - provisioned accounts
      - access credentials delivered securely

  - id: kickoff
    name: Kickoff Meeting
    owner: project_manager
    sla: 5 business days from intake
    description: Schedule and conduct the project kickoff meeting with the client.
    depends_on: account-setup
    outputs:
      - kickoff minutes
      - agreed timeline and milestones

  - id: handoff
    name: Team Handoff
    owner: project_manager
    sla: 2 business days after kickoff
    description: Assign owners and transfer the client to the delivery team.
    depends_on: kickoff
    outputs:
      - assigned delivery owners
      - completed handoff checklist

# Assumption: the account manager is notified when a step is overdue.
notifications:
  on_step_overdue: account_manager
  on_completion: account_manager, project_manager
